## Rowwise operations

In essence `rowwise` treats each each row as its own group

In this example the highest number between breaches and admissions appears in `max_col`

```{r}
library(NHSRdatasets)

data <- NHSRdatasets::ae_attendances

data |>
  dplyr::filter(org_code == "RF4",
                type == 1) |>
  dplyr::rowwise() |>
  dplyr::mutate(max_col = max(admissions, breaches, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

```

:::{.callout-tip collapse=false appearance='default' icon=true}
`rowwise` is a grouping function and needs to be ungrouped
:::
